questions: The last survivor of an order that first appeared over 290 million years ago, this long-lived East Asian tree with unique fan-shaped leaves is celebrated as a living fossil — what is it?
Ginkgo biloba: Species of tree. Fossils similar to the living species, belonging to the genus Ginkgo, extend back to the Middle Jurassic epoch about 170 million years ago.
Botanical taxa named by Carl Linnaeus

Starting out in snowmobile racing across Quebec, this Canadian driver rose to Formula One, finishing runner-up in the 1979 World Drivers' Championship with Ferrari and winning six Grands Prix — who is he?
Gilles Villeneuve (French; 18 January 1950 - 8 May 1982) was a Canadian racing driver, who competed in Formula One from 1977 to 1982.

Once the youngest-ever chair of the Scottish Labour Party, this fiery British politician later founded the Respect Party and, more recently, the Workers Party of Britain — now living in self-imposed exile in Russia. Who is he?
George Galloway (born 16 August 1954) is a British politician, broadcaster, and writer.

Bring Me to Life: Evanescence. "Bring Me to Life" is the debut single by American rock band Evanescence from their debut studio album, Fallen (2003).
